sourceAdaptationDecisions: Translate every learner-facing heading, meaning, example translation and source attribution; preserve all Japanese examples/readings/forms, stable metadata/types/tags/levels and source qualifications.
Preserve何なに/なんexpression dependence, counter restrictions,何曜日/何色; who versus indefinite someone and two separateか functions; politeどなたwithout universal sentence politeness.
Preserveあなたsocial/register limitations and frequent omission;自分reference/viewpoint and ownagency versus physicalsolitude. No invented character etymologies or categorical Russian-pronoun equivalents.
Preserveいつgeneral-time versus何時clock-time, usual absence ofにin basicいつquestions,いかがassessment/offer notgood,どうmanner/evaluation nota nounmodifier,どうしてreason/method contrast andなぜembeddedか.

Adapt irrelevant Englishplease/yesno/well comparisons into self-contained Russian function explanations without deleting Japanese rules: request/invitation syntax, negative questions, attentive acknowledgment, shortenedthanks versus intensification, and discourse signal versus goodmanner.
Preserveくださいimperativeofくださる/nounを/verbて/negativeないで/indirectいただけますか, andええaffirmative versus hesitation/surprise/regionalgood. Retain all original Japanese utterances and source qualifications.
